item.title: Daniel Jones: Sticking as starting quarterback
item.description:
Head coach Shane Steichen said that Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback heading into Sunday's game against the Colts, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jonathon Brooks: Could start practicing soon
item.description:
Panthers head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Brooks (core) will "potentially" be designated for return from injured reserve this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Travis Etienne: Chance to practice in Week 9
item.description:
Head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne (hamstring) will be evaluated Monday before the Saints make a determination whether he practices this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jordyn Tyson: Uncertain to practice this week
item.description:
Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that the Saints will decide by Wednesday whether to open Tyson's (hamstring) 21-day practice window this week, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Footballreports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: A.J. Brown: Practice participation this week TBD
item.description:
When asked whether Brown (ankle/knee) might practice at some point this week, coach Mike Vrabel said Monday "We'll see," Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.
